finalText: Fixed. `resolveRelease` in `packages/shared/config.js` was doing a shallow `Object.assign`, so any package overriding one key inside `output` or `sourcemap` (e.g. `@acme/api` setting `output.format`) silently dropped the sibling keys (`output.dir`, etc.), which then failed `build.js`'s bundle-stage config check. Replaced it with a proper per-key deep merge across the defaults/package-override/CLI-flag layers. `node verify.js` now passes (`build.js` builds green, 0 errors) and the layering rule holds for the untested override case too.
